# dayloop v0.12.0-rc2 — P5R UI review build

This prerelease is an installable candidate for checking the latest P5R navigation, visual, and Confidant-page changes on a real device.

## What changed since rc1

- Separated the system status-bar area from the app banner to remove the crowded overlap.
- Moved the active destination name into the top banner and made bottom navigation icon-only while preserving accessibility labels.
- Replaced jagged cards and polka-dot/halftone surfaces with cleaner chamfers, diagonal cut-lines, layered red blades, and white keylines.
- Removed spoiler shrouds from walkthrough steps, Confidant names, and Confidant rank notes.
- Added 22 supplied Confidant character cutouts as moderate, translucent lower-right backgrounds on their matching detail pages.
- Included the completed P5R route, activity, trophy, and content audit now present on `main`.

## What to check

- The status bar remains visually separate from the P5R banner on devices with different cutouts and status-bar heights.
- Each bottom icon opens the expected destination and the banner title follows the active tab or detail page.
- Confidant art is readable at the lower right without becoming too small, dominating the page, or obscuring rank information.
- Walkthrough steps and Confidant details appear immediately without reveal controls.
- Pack switching, progress controls, calendar navigation, achievements, search, and the home-screen widget continue to work.

## Candidate APK notes

- This APK is **not production-signed**. It uses Android's standard debug signing key for hands-on testing.
- Its application id is `com.shadowmonarchbooks.dayloop.candidate`, so it can be installed alongside the production Dayloop app.
- Its profiles, progress, and settings are separate from the stable app.
- Version: `0.12.0-rc2` (`versionCode 15`).

_Fan-made tool, not affiliated with or endorsed by ATLUS/SEGA._
